mapper.select: select status from analysis_report where report_id=#{id}
select primary_cancer_id from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id}
mapper.update: update omics.analysis_report a set a.primary_cancer_id = (select distinct c.class_id from nkb.disease aa join nkb.nkb_do_tree b on aa.do_id = b.id join omics.disease_class c on b.parent_id = c.do_id and c.disease_area = 'onco' join omics.sample_file s on aa.disease_name_chinese = s.clinicalremark where s.subbarcode = a.subbarcode) where a.primary_cancer_id is null and a.subbarcode = #{0} and a.report_id=#{1}
mapper.select: select distinct count(c.class_id) from nkb.disease aa join nkb_do_tree b on aa.do_id = b.id join disease_class c on b.parent_id = c.do_id and c.disease_area = 'onco' join sample_file s on aa.disease_name_chinese = s.clinicalremark where s.subbarcode = #{subbarcode}
select class_id,disease_class_chinese from disease_class where class_id=(select primary_cancer_id from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id})

select class_id,disease_class_chinese from disease_class where disease_class_chinese IN (select disease_type from sample_file where subbarcode IN (select subbarcode from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id})) and disease_area = 'onco' limit 1
mapper.update: update analysis_report set primary_cancer_id =#{0} where report_id = #{1}
update analysis_report set product_id =#{0} where report_id = #{1}
mapper.select: select disease_class_chinese from disease_class where class_id=#{primary_cancer_id}
select product_id,product_name_chinese from product where product_id=(select product_id from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id})
select product_id,product_name_chinese from product where path_name=#{path_name} limit 1
select product_name from product where product_id=#{product_id}

select class_id,disease_class_chinese from disease_class where disease_class_chinese IN (select Cancertype from sample_file where subbarcode IN (select subbarcode from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id})) and disease_area = 'onco' limit 1
select gender from sample_file where subbarcode = (select subbarcode from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id})
select analysis_date from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id}
select analyzer from analysis_report where report_id=#{report_id}
select file_path from data_file_status where subbarcode=#{subbarcode} and analysis_date=#{analysis_date} limit 1
select class_id from disease_class where disease_class_chinese=#{disease_class_chinese}
select count(file_id) from data_file_status where subbarcode = #{subbarcode} and analysis_date = #{analysis_date} and (status = 'Pending' or status = 'Error')
select product_name, type as product_type from product where product_id=#{product_id}
select product_name, type as product_type from product where product_name=#{product_name} or path_name=#{product_name} limit 1
